verses.english: “Sir, they speak of a one ‘wise and clever’.

verses.pali: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, ‘paññavā aneḷamūgo’ti vuccatī”ti?
verses.english: How is a person who is wise and clever defined?”

verses.pali: “Sattannaṁ kho, bhikkhu, bojjhaṅgānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ‘paññavā aneḷamūgo’ti vuccati.
verses.english: “Mendicant, they’re called wise and clever because they’ve developed and cultivated the seven awakening factors.
The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity.

verses.pali: imesaṁ kho, bhikkhu, sattannaṁ bojjhaṅgānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ‘paññavā aneḷamūgo’ti vuccatī”ti.
verses.english: They’re called wise and clever because they’ve developed and cultivated these seven awakening factors.”
